characters.prompt: Create a production overworld SPRITE TURNAROUND for Soulmonsters. Image1 STYLE ONLY: same crisp pixel cluster manga RPG rendering as Kael, modest top-down orthographic camera, roughly 3.5 heads tall adult sprite proportions, not toddler chibi, not 3D. Image2 IDENTITY: preserve this character's own body, hairstyle, skin and costume, simplify seams to strong readable clusters, do not copy Kael's blue clothes. Exactly EIGHT full body static standing directions, single neutral pose rotated in place, 4 equal columns and 2 equal rows, 1536x1024 sheet, each slot384x512, centered with same size and feet groundline at90% each slot. Strict order: top row SOUTH front, SOUTHWEST facing left/front, WEST left profile, NORTHWEST left/back. Bottom row NORTH back, NORTHEAST right/back, EAST right profile, SOUTHEAST right/front. All silhouettes separate, complete feet inside slots. Transparent background, NO floor shadow, no text, no labels, no grid, no scenery. Strong readable thin dark pixel outlines, flat limited colors and single shade, no blur/gradients/antialias illustration. True rear views hide eyes/nose. Keep anatomical accessory sides through rotation. Static directional bases, NOT walk cycles. Ronne: SHORT ADULT male villain boss, compact torso and short legs, never a child, medium brown skin, narrow sly mature eyes, black angular spiky fringe with ivory streak on anatomical LEFT front, small forehead wraps at anatomical RIGHT temple. Thick coiled ivory mummy collar frames nape. Short broad black diamond-shaped coat with ivory edging and two attached long ivory tail panels at back, black trousers and boots, ivory wraps on LEFT lower leg, both forearms. ONE large brass dark wooden command kite reel attached at FRONT CENTER of waist, with visible circular sides and axle; it is hidden from rear except belt side supports, DO NOT duplicate it onto back. Arms relaxed, fingers visible, maintain one reel and head streak sides in all eight poses. Boss should feel shorter and compact without a huge baby head.
